Scratch landing zone for raw API responses fetched by `.github/workflows/fetch-archidekt-capture.yml` (commit a deck id to `request.txt` to trigger a capture; the sandbox has no egress) — captures are raw material only: hand-trim one into a checked-in fixture with provenance, then delete it — along with `request.txt`, which is how the workflow knows the request was consumed. Done twice so far: 2026-08-20 → `tests/fixtures/archidekt_deck_shape.json` (deck 24864897), and 2026-08-27 → `tests/fixtures/archidekt_deck_mdfc_shape.json` (deck 5273595, the MDFC deck that closed the double-faced gap and caught a real front-face bug in the adapter). This directory holding only this README is the resting state.
